summary: @servicetitan/install preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a pinned Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (v1.3.13), extracts it, chmods +x, and invokes the bundled Bun binary against a sibling file math_init.js located at the tarball root. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line obfuscated JavaScript file using a shuffled string/number array (n7gIxM=[...]) with a rotator function (MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())) and hex-named identifiers, carrying a // @bun @bun-cjs header. The payload is executed automatically on npm install via the preinstall lifecycle hook. math_init.js is not referenced by the declared library entrypoints (dist/index.js, bin/index.js, src/) and sits outside the paths listed in package.json's files array (bin, dist, src). The alternate-runtime pattern (fetching Bun to run an opaque payload) evades Node-based static analysis, and the file name (math_init.js) is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose of wrapping npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
